tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Warm off-white page canvas. The background behind all cards.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Primary dashboard card surface. Carries text-primary and text-secondary.

tokens.name: bg-soft
tokens.usage: Nested panels and quiet fields inside a card. Carries text-primary.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text, headings and data values on bg-card, bg-canvas and bg-soft (13.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, captions and chart axis labels on bg-card (4.9:1) and bg-canvas (4.5:1). Not for text on bg-soft below 14px.

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline on card edges only (1.2:1). Never the sole signal for a control, state or boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Meaningful borders that must be seen: input outlines, toggle tracks, chart axes, unchecked checkboxes (3.5:1 on bg-card).

tokens.name: action-dark
tokens.usage: Text links, focus-visible ring and active nav state on bg-card (7.6:1) and bg-canvas (7.0:1).

tokens.name: action-mint
tokens.usage: Filled surface of the primary button. Pair only with on-action-mint, never white text.

tokens.name: on-action-mint
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action-mint button (10.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-lavender
tokens.usage: Calendar and progress group fills. A grouping colour, not a text colour.

tokens.name: accent-peach
tokens.usage: Reminder and scheduled-event fills. A grouping colour, not a text colour.

tokens.name: accent-butter
tokens.usage: Milestone and celebration fills. A grouping colour, not a text colour.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Insight and analytics illustration fills. A grouping colour, not a text colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any accent-* pastel fill (9.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on bg-card (6.1:1). Always accompanied by a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive feedback text and icon on bg-card (6.5:1). Always accompanied by a word or icon.

families.heading: "LINE Seed Sans KR", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif
families.number: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: Page greeting at the top of the overview.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section titles above a card group.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Task rows, table cells, filter labels and descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and selected filter labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, chart axis labels, helper text. Pair with text-secondary.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: The single large figure on a KPI card. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a tight group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding minimum; gap between bento cells.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding default; gap between sections on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; gap between major sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a new region of the overview.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Desktop dashboard cards and side sheets.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects and small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, status pills and the avatar.

shadow.note: Soft and sparse. Only where a surface genuinely floats.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting dashboard card, paired with a border-soft hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card on hover, with translateY(-3px).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Side sheet, modal and dropdown menu.

tokens.name: layout-max
tokens.usage: Max content width of the dashboard shell.

tokens.name: layout-page-padding
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width at 1280px and above.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar width between 768px and 1279px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header containing search, notifications, date and user.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target size for checkboxes, icon buttons and calendar cells.

duration.note: Motion is tied to events, never ambient. All of these collapse to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Card lift and colour change on hover.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Side sheet slide-in when a calendar item is selected.

tokens.name: dur-entry
tokens.usage: Staggered card entrance on first paint.

tokens.name: dur-complete
tokens.usage: Checkbox tick draw and the task row rearranging.

tokens.name: dur-counter
tokens.usage: KPI count-up, played once when the card is revealed.
